summary: Source-anchored research for Bank Conflict Elimination in Non-Sequential Tensor Reads. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Empirical bus utilization during MoE token dispatch increases by 28-35% on GDDR7 compared to GDDR6 32-bit channels due to eliminated bank conflicts. (high confidence)
